Definition: crimson, properly, the insect or its color, also stuff dyed with it
BiblicalUsage: 1) scarlet, crimson; 1a) properly, the insect 'coccus ilicis', the dried body of the female yielding colouring matter from which is made the dye used for cloth to colour it scarlet or crimson
